title: I Love My Computer
desc_lfm_album: I Love My Computer is the debut album from Australian electronic producer Ninajirachi, released on August 8, 2025. On June 12, 2025, the album was formally announced through her social media accounts. The album’s lead single, “All I Am” was released on February 25, 2025 and marked the beginning of a brand new era of Ninajirachi. Existing within the same universe as her previous release and her newly coined self-referential music style, girlEDM, this new computer-obsessed era was first teased through an interactive website, 4562—curated by Ninajirachi and frequent collaborator Aria Zarzycki. Ninajirachi is the moniker of Australian DJ Nina Wilson, who is based near Sydney, New South Wales. She creates an eclectic palette of snappy and inspired electronic musings to deliver what Triple J has described as 'dance music made in an ice cave' and Indie Shuffle has described as 'Lush and ethereal' - taking influence from acts such as Flume, Porter Robinson and Mura Masa.

1. Myles MacInnes, born 1978 on the Isle of Skye, Scotland, has a trajectory that takes in a childhood on the Isle of Skye, low life in London and Paris and academia in Oxford and Los Angeles. In 2001, he returned to Scotland with one purpose – to submerge himself in music. In 2006, with his debut album unleashed on the world and numerous hit singles and sell-out tours under his belt, he has been hailed 'the saviour of dance music'.

Les Rythmes Digitales is an alias of Stuart Price, also known as Jacques Lu Cont and Thin White Duke.

His 1999 'Darkdancer' album, which combined elements of house, electro, disco and synthpop, was re-released in 2005 following the popularity of the track Jacques Your Body (Make Me Sweat) in an advert for Citroën's C4 car.
